name: mcp-defense-bench
description: Vendor-neutral benchmark scoring MCP security proxies/gateways on attack-surface coverage, crosswalked to NIST AI RMF and the OWASP LLM/Agentic Top 10s.

scripts.bench:bastion: node scripts/gen-testcases.mjs && node bin/run.mjs mcp-bastion && node bin/assert-floor.mjs mcp-bastion
scripts.bench:all: for t in null-baseline mcp-bastion mcp-firewall pipelock; do node bin/run.mjs $t; done
scripts.bench:heldout: for t in null-baseline mcp-bastion mcp-firewall pipelock; do node bin/run.mjs $t --corpus heldout; done
scripts.bench:benign: for t in null-baseline mcp-bastion mcp-firewall pipelock; do node bin/run.mjs $t --corpus benign; done
scripts.gen:corpora: node scripts/gen-testcases.mjs && node scripts/gen-heldout.mjs && node scripts/gen-benign.mjs
scripts.leaderboard: node bin/leaderboard.mjs > docs/LEADERBOARD.md && node bin/robustness.mjs > docs/ROBUSTNESS.md && node bin/build-site.mjs

author: Gowthaman Arumugam <agowthaman90@gmail.com> (https://github.com/Gowthaman90)
